info.title: Waystation API
info.description: A set of tools that connect ChatGPT to productivity apps

get.summary: List all Google Docs in your Drive
get.description: Retrieves a list of Google Docs associated with the authenticated user's Drive.

200.description: A JSON array of Google Docs

id.description: Unique identifier for the Google Doc

url.description: URL to access the Google Doc

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on the server.

get.summary: Read the content of a specific Google Doc
get.description: Retrieves the content of a specified Google Doc that the authenticated user has access to.

parameters.name: docId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Google Doc to read

content.description: The text content of the Google Doc

title.description: The title of the Google Doc

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid or missing document ID

404.description: Not Found - Document not found or inaccessible

500.description: Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on the server
